# Environment variables

Intro text with a table that is not the variables table:

| File                      | Who it affects |
| ------------------------- | -------------- |
| `~/.claude/settings.json` | You            |

## Variables

Some prose first.

| Variable                       | Purpose                                                         |
| :----------------------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`            | API key sent as the `X-Api-Key` header. See [docs](/docs/en/x). |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_THINKING` | Turns **thinking** off.                                         |
| `OLD_VAR`                      | Removed in v2.1.100. It did nothing after that.                 |
| `BASH_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS`      | Default timeout for Bash commands.                              |

## Later section

| Variable         | Purpose                             |
| :--------------- | :---------------------------------- |
| `NOT_A_REAL_ONE` | Example table that must be ignored. |
